answer: Reputation-Linked Resource Quotas: each agent identity draws compute and API access from a shared pool throttled by a cedar-scored track record built from verified work history. A new identity starts in a cold haven of low quotas. Sustained abuse by many wallets collapses the operator's score, since scoring aggregates behavior to the operator account, triggering tundra-level throttling across every identity they run. An attacker must fund real work to climb out, paying full compute cost per identity.
